slides.texte_overlay:
Simple ways to become
more attractive to women (respectfully)
Be kind first. Kindness to everyone, friends and strangers alike, is one of the most attractive qualities a man can have.
Take care of your health. Sleep, sport, real food. Energy and good mood show on your face and in how you move.
Be someone with plans. Trips, projects, goals. A man going somewhere is more interesting than one waiting for life to happen.
Listen properly. Ask questions, remember details, follow up later. Being truly heard is rare and very attractive.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Curiosity makes you a much more interesting person to be around.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Curiosity makes you a much more interesting person to be around.

slides.texte_overlay: Have a sense of humour. Laugh easily, don't take yourself too seriously. Light, warm fun makes people want to stay.
Respect her decisions. Interested or not, a respectful man always leaves a good impression. Always, whatever the answer.
